summary.text: Steve Drazkowski is a Republican member of the Minnesota Senate for District 20, elected to the Senate in 2022 after winning a 2007 special election to the House and being re-elected there through 2020.
His official Senate page lists committee assignments in Environment, Climate, and Legacy, State and Local Government, and Taxes.

sources.title: Senator Steve Drazkowski (20, R) - Minnesota Senate
